title: Frozen Liquids Defy Gravity
description: Discover the mind-bending world of superfluids and their ability to flow uphill.

scenes.narration: At a temperature near absolute zero, certain liquids defy gravity.
They can flow uphill and escape their containers.
This phenomenon is known as superfluidity.
In a superfluid, particles can move without viscosity or friction.
This means they can climb walls and ignore gravity.
The result is a liquid that flows like a living thing.
